docs.author: Dr. Noor Haddad
sentences: Patient is a 66-year-old woman with low back pain for about three months.
No fever, weight loss, saddle numbness or cancer history.
Referred to physical therapy at the last visit.
Pain radiates down the right leg to the foot.
Strength is 5/5 in both legs and reflexes are symmetric.
Plan: MRI of the lumbar spine without contrast.
docs.title: Orthopedic clinic visit note

payer_letter: Bluepeak Insurance has reviewed claim A-1026 for MRI of the lumbar spine. Coverage requires documentation of at least six weeks of conservative treatment together with radicular findings or an objective neurological deficit, or a red flag condition. The records submitted do not document at least six weeks of conservative treatment before imaging. You may request reconsideration within 90 days of this notice.
